genius.licensingRegulator: NYDFS (Standard Custody & Trust Company, LLC limited-purpose trust charter)
genius.notes: RLUSD is issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, LLC (SCTC), a New York limited-purpose trust company. Current issuer legal terms, NYDFS directory/issuance greenlisting and the latest opened reserve report identify that same issuer. Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB) is a separate proposed reserve-management/collateral-trustee affiliate: the December 12, 2025 OCC decision expressly says it does not plan to issue stablecoins and grants only preliminary conditional approval before preopening conditions. The OCC affiliate charter must not be used to name OCC as the current GENIUS primary federal regulator of SCTC or as an RLUSD PPSI approval. Ripple issuer statements signal GENIUS-era intent; no public regulator approval/application qualifying SCTC under GENIUS was located in reviewed sources. The final federal/state-qualified route remains unknown: ordinary NYDFS issuance approval is real, but no SCRC-approved state regime or token-specific GENIUS state qualification was established. September 30 SCRC procedural rules expressly postpone accepting certifications pending PRA approval and a Treasury notice. The framework remains pre-effective. ReserveDisclosurePresent and monthlyAttestationPresent refer to the current issuer hub and separately published independent examination, not to RNTB authorization or assurance about all Ripple entities. Redemption at $1 is governed by SCTC legal terms and onboarding eligibility. No relevant public SCTC/RLUSD enforcement action was found in the reviewed NYDFS index and targeted regulator search; actions against other Ripple affiliates are not automatically this issuer action.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No qualifying public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval or issuer application naming Standard Custody & Trust Company, LLC/RLUSD was found in these reviewed sources and targeted regulator-domain searches. NYDFS trust/issuance permissions are not GENIUS state qualification; the OCC conditional charter is for a separate non-issuing reserve affiliate. Current OCC charter table is not an exhaustive PPSI register and rulemaking alone is not proof that no confidential filing exists. No relevant SCTC/RLUSD issuer enforcement action was located in the consulted NYDFS index/search.
